interpretation: Exploratory comparison on a previously opened test set; not independent validation. The posterior predictive interval is model-based uncertainty, while the conformal interval adds calibration from the existing calibration partition.
method_notes: Native intervals are equal-tailed quantiles of the posterior mixture of individual event times, including future-event variation; they are not survival-curve credible intervals.
Conformalized intervals use the same native endpoints, widened by the frozen conservative score-envelope quantile.
Coverage bounds are compatible with right-censored outcomes, not direct observations of latent coverage. IPCW assumes independent censoring and adequate support.
Bootstrap confidence intervals condition on the fitted model, calibration state and training censoring estimate.
